apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.1.0 — the audit fixes: swara chips now wrap onto the next line like the web; Loops is a chip collection (groups drill in, a group chip loops its whole section, tap the active loop chip again to deselect); playback highlights no longer rebuild whole screens; the fullscreen player waveform no longer re-renders the tabs 20 times a second.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Audit fixes: chip wrap, loops chip collection, render isolation.
